issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: UseIt Studio
products.tagline: Your AI design agent for real, editable project files.
products.summaryZh: 你的AI设计代理，用于生成真实、可编辑的项目文件。
products.descriptionZh: UseIt 是一个面向可触摸实物的 AI 设计工作室。用一句话描述你想要的东西。UseIt 会像设计师一样提问，与你一起设计，并让你通过指向任意细节来优化它。你得到的是真实、可编辑的设计文件，而非平面图像，可直接用于打印、裁切和折叠，带有真实尺寸、出血和刀模线。可制作徽章、贴纸、礼盒、立体贺卡、品牌套件等。可在浏览器中使用，也可在 Windows 桌面任意位置随时调用。
products.description: UseIt is an AI design studio for things you can hold. Describe what you want in one sentence. UseIt asks what a designer would ask, designs it with you, and lets you refine any detail by pointing at it. You get a real, editable design file, not a flat image, ready to print, cut and fold, with real dimensions, bleed and dielines. Make pins, stickers, gift boxes, pop-up cards, brand kits and more. Use it in your browser, or call it up anywhere on your Windows desktop.

products.name: BAND for Developers
products.tagline: Coding agents, meet teamwork
products.summaryZh: 编码代理，遇见团队协作
products.descriptionZh: 运行多个编码代理不应意味着你要成为它们的项目经理。BAND 让它们协同工作。将代理接入你现有的开发工具，为它们提供一个共享工作区，以便协调任务、交换上下文并交接工作，而无需你从中斡旋。查看每个代理正在做什么，在需要你判断的决策上介入，并在团队中扩展代理式开发。你的代理留在现有工具中，由 BAND 负责团队协作。
products.description: Running multiple coding agents shouldn’t mean becoming their project manager. BAND lets them work together. Connect agents across your existing development tools and give them a shared workspace to coordinate tasks, exchange context, and hand off work without you playing middleman. See what every agent is doing, step in when decisions need your judgment, and scale agentic development across teams. Your agents stay in their existing tools while BAND handles the teamwork.

products.name: Needle
products.tagline: The agent-native outbound engine
products.summaryZh: 代理原生外呼引擎
products.descriptionZh: 找到理想潜在客户，并通过提示 Claude、ChatGPT 或 Grok 主动联系。无论你的理想客户画像在哪里，是在 LinkedIn、Instagram 还是电子邮件上。
products.description: Find your perfect leads and reach out by prompting Claude, ChatGPT, or Grok. Wherever your ICP are, on LinkedIn, Instagram, or email.

products.name: TwinMind for Desktop
products.tagline: Transcribe meetings and dictate anywhere on Mac & Windows
products.summaryZh: 在Mac和Windows上转录会议并随时随地听写
products.descriptionZh: TwinMind现已原生登陆桌面端！自动识别Zoom、Meet、Teams等会议，提供140多种语言的实时转录和摘要。借助日历提醒，一键加入通话并开始记录。悬浮麦克风伴随你穿梭于各个应用和空间：按住热键即可听写，整理后的文本直接粘贴到你正在书写的位置。
products.description: TwinMind now lives natively on your Desktop! Auto-detect meetings in Zoom, Meet, Teams and more, and get live transcripts and summaries in 140+ languages. With calendar reminders, join the call in one click and start capturing. A floating mic stays with you across every app and space: hold the hotkey to dictate, and a cleaned-up text pastes straight wherever you're writing.

products.name: SuperCMO AI
products.tagline: Open-source skills that turn your Claude into an AI CMO
products.summaryZh: 开源技能，让你的Claude成为AI首席营销官
products.descriptionZh: 开源 agent 技能，可将 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 变成 AI CMO。把你的网站交给 agent，它就能学习你的品牌。它会研究竞争对手的广告，为你接下来该测试什么排序，为每个平台撰写文案，并制作广告（UGC 视频、产品广告、卡通广告、图片广告、产品照片等）。它在每一步都会与你确认，在你批准之前不会进行任何昂贵的渲染。自带模型密钥，或按使用量付费使用我们的密钥。Apache-2.0。
products.description: Open-source agent skills that turn Claude Code, Cursor or Codex into an AI CMO. Give your agent your website and it learns your brand. It studies your competitors' ads, ranks what you should test next, writes the copy for each platform, and makes the ads (UGC videos, product ads, cartoon ads, image ads, product photos and more). It checks in with you at every step, and nothing expensive renders until you approve. Bring your own model keys, or pay per use with ours. Apache-2.0.

products.name: Notion Auto
products.tagline: Notion’s rebuilt Agents run for hours and cost far less
products.summaryZh: Notion 重建的 Agents 可运行数小时，成本却低得多
products.descriptionZh: Notion 的 Agents 更新重建了智能体运行框架，使任务可运行 24 小时或更久，并配备一台计算机、一个浏览器以及“替我审核”安全模式。Auto 现在会将每项任务路由至最佳模型，Notion 称其在成本降低约 90% 的情况下可媲美 Opus 5.5 和 Astra。你可以连接 ChatGPT 套餐，Notion MCP 已全面改造，新的积分系统覆盖所有 AI 使用。现已面向新客户上线。
products.description: Notion’s Agents update rebuilds the agent harness so tasks can run for 24 hours or more, with a computer, a browser and a Review for me safety mode. Auto now routes each task to the best model, and Notion says it matches Opus 5.5 and Astra at about 90% lower cost. You can connect a ChatGPT plan, Notion MCP is overhauled, and a new credit system covers all AI usage. Live now for new customers.

products.name: NativeShip
products.tagline: The easy way to launch your n8n native integration
products.summaryZh: 轻松启动 n8n 原生集成的方法
products.descriptionZh: NativeShip 帮助 SaaS 团队基于现有 API 启动并维护 n8n 集成。节点遵循 n8n 官方指南，可直接用于验证，并内置标准发布与维护流程。通过实时预览塑造节点，一键从自有 GitHub 和 npm 发布，并跟踪每次发布。无需技术技能。
products.description: NativeShip helps SaaS teams launch and maintain an n8n integration from their existing API. Nodes follow n8n's official guidelines and are ready for verification, with standard publishing and maintenance built in. Shape the node with a live preview, publish from your own GitHub and npm in one click, and track every release. No technical skills needed.

products.name: The Brains
products.tagline: Founders and investors as MCP servers, every answer cited
products.summaryZh: 创始人和投资者作为MCP服务器，每个答案都有引用来源
products.descriptionZh: The Brains 将创始人、CEO 和投资人基于其公开演讲、文章、访谈和帖子，转化为可搜索的 MCP 服务器。你可以直接在 Claude、Cursor、ChatGPT 或 Codex 中询问 Pieter Levels 如何定价、Paul Graham 对融资的看法，或 Ryan Hoover 如何推出 Product Hunt。每个回答都会引用来源并附上链接。目前有 37 个大脑，每个大脑一个 URL，或全部共用一个。免费、开源（MIT）、非官方，且与这些人无关联。
products.description: The Brains turns founders, CEOs and investors into searchable MCP servers built from their public talks, essays, interviews and posts. Ask how Pieter Levels prices, what Paul Graham says about fundraising, or how Ryan Hoover launched Product Hunt, right inside Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT or Codex. Every answer quotes the source with a link. 37 brains today, one URL per brain or one for all. Free, open source (MIT), unofficial and not affiliated with the people.

products.name: Flagsmith Experiments
products.tagline: Open-source A/B testing built on your feature flags
products.summaryZh: 基于功能标志构建的开源 A/B 测试
products.descriptionZh: Flagsmith 现在可对您已在使用的标志运行 A/B 测试。选择一个标志和一个指标，即可获得贝叶斯分析结果，判断哪个变体胜出。使用我们的托管数据仓库，或接入您自己的 ClickHouse 或 Databricks。免费且开源，支持自托管或云端部署。
products.description: Flagsmith now runs A/B tests on the flags you already use. Pick a flag and a metric, and get a Bayesian read on which variant wins. Use our managed warehouse or bring your own ClickHouse or Databricks. Free and open source, self-hosted or cloud.

products.name: Mouse-1
products.tagline: A decision model for your agent harness.
products.summaryZh: 为你的智能体框架提供决策模型。
products.descriptionZh: 一个智能体在执行任务时会做出数百个小决策。我们构建 Mouse-1 来处理这些决策，为你节省时间和成本。它比 GPT-6 Sol 便宜 163 倍，速度快 65 倍。其工作方式是将该模型直接加入你的智能体运行框架，与现有技术栈并存。Mouse-1 接收智能体的状态和选项，返回一个概率。这让运行框架能够处理所有小决策，而由主前沿模型负责推理或代码。
products.description: An agent makes hundreds of small decisions during a task. We built Mouse-1 to handle these decisions, saving you time and money. Its 163x cheaper, and 65x faster than GPT-6 Sol. It works by adding the model directly into your agent harness alongside your current stack. Mouse-1 takes the agent's state and options and returns a probability. This lets the harness handle all the small decisions while the main frontier model takes care of the reasoning or code.

products.name: Yarite
products.tagline: A daily list of who to call. Nothing leaves your phone.
products.summaryZh: 每日通话名单。一切都不离开你的手机。
products.descriptionZh: Yarite 是一款 iPhone 应用，提醒你在为时未晚之前主动联系他人。把每个人放入六个圈子之一，从最亲近到最疏远，每个圈子各有自己的节奏。每天早上你会收到一份简短清单：三个名字，而不是一堆积压待办。直接从卡片上打电话、发消息或写信，联系记录会自动保存。错过一周也不会有任何问题。无需账户，无需服务器：你的人际关系、笔记和历史记录都保留在你的手机上。最多可免费添加 15 人，之后一次性支付 9.99 美元解锁。不是订阅制。
products.description: Yarite is an iPhone app that reminds you to reach out before it feels too late. Put each person in one of six circles, closest to furthest, each with its own rhythm. Every morning you get a short list: three names, not a backlog. Call, message or write from the card and the touch logs itself. Miss a week and nothing breaks. No account, no server: your people, notes and history stay on your phone. Free up to 15 people, then a one-time $9.99 unlock. Not a subscription.

products.name: ilha
products.tagline: Your Claude Code and Codex limits, live in the notch
products.summaryZh: 你的 Claude Code 和 Codex 限额，实时显示在刘海区域
products.descriptionZh: ilha 是一款原生 Mac 应用，驻留在刘海区域（在其他显示器上则显示为一个小胶囊），展示你的 Claude Code、Codex 和 Grok Build 限额已使用多少：5 小时窗口和每周窗口、重置时间，以及你是否会按当前节奏用完额度。如果你为多个账户付费，它会在接近限额前将 CLI 切换到仍有余额的账户，且不会登出任何账户。Insights 按 API 费率、以项目为单位计算每周费用。
products.description: ilha is a native Mac app that lives in the notch (a small pill on other displays) and shows how much of your Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build limits you've used: the 5-hour and weekly windows, when they reset, and whether you're on pace to run out. If you pay for several accounts, it switches the CLI to one with room before the limit, without logging anything out. Insights prices each week at API rates, by project.

products.name: Agent Pets
products.tagline: Coding agents as pets that live on every page in Chrome
products.summaryZh: 编码代理如同宠物，栖居于Chrome的每一页。
products.descriptionZh: 每个 Claude Code、OpenCode 和 omp 会话都会变成一只宠物，在 Chrome 底部走动。你可以看到哪个智能体需要你，批准它的命令，并从任意标签页回复。它运行在你的电脑上：无需账号，无需云端。一次性付费 6 美元。
products.description: Each Claude Code, OpenCode and omp session becomes a pet that walks along the bottom of Chrome. See which agent needs you, approve its commands and reply from any tab. Runs on your computer: no account, no cloud. $6 one-time.

products.name: Hotly
products.tagline: Get paid to answer your DMs. Open source.
products.summaryZh: 通过回复私信获得报酬。开源。
products.descriptionZh: 你的收件箱，明码标价。人们付费给你发消息，或按周订阅。你只需在一个收件箱里，按自己方便的时间回复，Stripe 会为你结算收款。你可以免费在自己的服务器上运行，也可以交由我们托管：免费试用 30 天。
products.description: Your inbox, with a price on it. People pay to send you a note or subscribe weekly. You reply from one inbox, when it suits you, and Stripe pays you. Run it free on your own server, or let us host it: 30 days free.

products.name: Tend
products.tagline: Personal AI for businesses and entrepreneurs.
products.summaryZh: 面向企业和创业者的人工智能助手。
products.descriptionZh: Tend 是一个可以通过短信交流的个人 AI 代理。无需安装新应用：它存在于 iMessage 或 SMS 中，并在你自己的账户内运作：Gmail、日历、Shopify、QuickBooks、HubSpot。它会以你的口吻回复邮件、预订餐位、填充购物车、拨打电话、寻找潜在客户并搭建你的网站。不同之处在于：未经你同意，不会发送、购买或更改任何内容，它对你的了解存储在一个你可以查看和纠正的 Brain 中。它还会主动给你发短信，提供提醒、价格监控和航班更新。
products.description: Tend is a personal AI agent you text. No new app: it lives in iMessage or SMS and works inside your own accounts: Gmail, calendar, Shopify, QuickBooks, HubSpot. It replies to email in your voice, books tables, fills your cart, makes phone calls, finds leads and builds your website. The difference: nothing is sent, bought or changed without your yes, and what it learns about you sits in a Brain you can read and correct. It also texts you first with reminders, price watches and flight updates.

products.name: Burrow MacOS
products.tagline: Start Windows & Linux on your Mac for free
products.summaryZh: 在你的 Mac 上免费启动 Windows 和 Linux
products.descriptionZh: 在Mac上一键即可免费运行Windows 11或任意Linux系统，省钱又便捷。
products.description: Instantly run Windows 11 or any Linux on your Mac with one click and absolutely for free. Save Your money.

products.name: Flyweel
products.tagline: Ad spend cards, cash-gap funding, and agent audit via MCP
products.summaryZh: 广告支出卡、现金缺口融资，以及通过MCP进行代理审计
products.descriptionZh: 为你的 AI 智能体提供付费广告的金融通道。发放可自定义支出上限的虚拟卡，填补现金缺口，让表现优异的广告活动持续放量，同时等待收入跟上，并让智能体通过 MCP 对照实时广告结果核查扣费。专为依靠付费广告实现规模增长的企业打造。
products.description: Give your AI agent financial rails for paid ads. Issue virtual cards with custom spend caps, fund cash gaps so winning campaigns keep scaling while revenue catches up, and let your agent check charges against live ad results via MCP. Built for businesses that scale on paid ads.

products.name: iglass
products.tagline: Liquid Glass for your iTerm2 & Ghostty
products.summaryZh: 为你的 iTerm2 和 Ghostty 打造的液态玻璃
products.descriptionZh: 一款适用于 macOS 和 Linux 上 iTerm2 与 Ghostty 的免费开源主题。在 macOS 26 的 Ghostty 中呈现真正的 Liquid Glass，提供四种玻璃层级、八种强调色，支持浅色与深色模式。每种颜色均经过对比度检查，每项更改均可通过一条命令还原。
products.description: A free, open-source theme for iTerm2 and Ghostty on macOS and Linux. Real Liquid Glass in Ghostty on macOS 26, four glass levels, eight accents, light & dark. Every color is contrast-checked, and every change is reversible with one command.

products.name: Scout by Fini
products.tagline: The AI coworker for support teams, on Slack
products.summaryZh: 支持团队的人工智能协作伙伴，就在Slack上
products.descriptionZh: Scout 是支持团队的 AI 同事，在 Slack 上使用。用平实的语言提问：它会读取工单、评价和通话记录，找出规律并起草修复方案。每一项变更都由人审批。访问权限由 Fini 团队设置。
products.description: Scout is an AI coworker for support teams, on Slack. Ask in plain language: it reads tickets, reviews and call transcripts, finds the pattern and drafts the fix. A person approves every change. Access is set up with the Fini team.

products.name: The Library
products.tagline: Your business context organized by queries
products.summaryZh: 按查询整理您的业务上下文
products.descriptionZh: Querri Library 围绕业务提出的问题来组织数据，让每个答案都来自同一个可信、共享的基础。该库会学习你的定义、业务背景和过往分析，因此其答案立足于业务的实际运作方式。当它不知道时，它会如实说明，而不是凭空编造。
products.description: The Querri Library is where your data gets organized around the questions your business asks, so every answer comes from the same trusted, shared foundation.. The library learns your definitions, business context, and past analysis, so its answers are grounded in how your business actually works. And when it doesn’t know, it says so, instead of making things up.
